text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Even in the same race... 
the pressure feels so completely 
different...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Furioso! What an impressive run! Now that 
is the true grit of Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Her track record of multiple strong 
showings in last autumn's GⅠ races was 
certainly no fluke!"

A crushing defeat could have caused a 
complete downfall. Somehow, status was 
maintained, but even so...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'll beat them... I'll beat them... No 
matter who comes... every last one of 
them..."

Right now, Furioso lacks the majestic 
presence of a Central champion.

All that remains is purely—"hostility." 
Nothing more.

Refusing to accept it, refusing to yield, 
fighting back, her little heart is aching. 
If things continue like this, can she 
really...
Can we really surpass Central, I wonder?

Can an Umamusume truly surpass the 
champions of the Twinkle Series with 
nothing but frustration as her driving 
force?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Furio. Hey, could we talk for a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly... you don't have to 
brood over it that much, do you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I get that they're trying their hardest 
for their hometown, but... being neighbors 
doesn't mean we have to be enemies.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—The world is wide. Wouldn't it be more 
fun if we all accepted each other and had 
a lively time together?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a network all over the world, 
and friends too. Looking at it from my 
perspective..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio looks like she's having a bit of a 
hard time right now. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Looks rough...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Please... leave me alone...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm different from Tran-san... different 
from the URA Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I've somehow made it this far. Just a 
little more... just...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I will win the Diolite Kinen in my 
hometown and reclaim Funabashi's pride.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Right now, that is... our top priority.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Furio...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right! There's no way we can 
lose!"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Furi-pyon, after all, you're the 
representative for all of us~!

Regional vs. Central. That gap won't be 
bridged easily, nor will the rivalry ever 
truly fade.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry. For just an informant, maybe 
I spoke a little out of turn.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today. I'm gonna use this as a 
stepping stone to do what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio has her dream, and I've got mine, 
y'know? Guess that's what they call 
diversity and stuff.

—And a few days later, a monumental piece 
of news was announced to the Umamusume 
world.

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
Incredible news! Three Japanese Umamusume 
have been confirmed to run in Dubai's 
international GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
Truly a big dream! A grand challenge for a 
crowning glory never before achieved!

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
First, Buena Vista-san and Transcend-san, 
please share your aspirations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'm inevitably seen as 
representing my country, so I want to run 
a race worthy of that!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of Buena-chan. Everyone's 
heroine, huh～ For me, rather than doing 
it for the country……

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I want to get to know people from all over 
the world. Maybe that's the bigger reason, 
actually.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Because, y'know, I wanna keep expanding 
our circle of friends more and more.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So Buena-chan, I'll leave the official 
comments to you~

—An overseas expedition. That was 
something on a level we couldn't even 
fathom.

While we were looking toward the JRA, 
Transcend was looking at the world. A 
world so far away...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
An expedition to Dubai... Carrying the 
hopes of the nation... So this is... the 
JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As the leader of the Umamusume world, I 
shall accept challenges with head held 
high... And in turn, challenge something 
even greater...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Central might not be arrogant. But... even 
so, no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Not until... this is settled...!

I found it harder and harder to see them 
as the enemy. The more I learned about the 
greatness and inner workings of the JRA.

It seems... to be approaching the limit. 
Her next race is scheduled to be the 
'Diolite Kinen', but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying will happen... if 
things stay as they are...?
choice_data_list:
You can't surpass Central. You'll just 
break yourself trying.

You can't surpass Central. You'll only end 
up breaking yourself.

text_block_list.text:
Still holding onto hatred for someone I 
truly want to acknowledge, praise, and 
spur each other on with...

"I can't accomplish defeating the JRA. 
That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I... don't want to! Please, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Please, just let me run the Diolite 
Kinen! Let me run as I am! Funabashi isn't 
weak!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I will win... and prove it... Taking that 
as my banner, all the way here...
Even if I did see it all the way through—
choice_data_list:
You'll probably just be left feeling empty 
inside, you know...?

I'm sure you'll only be left feeling empty 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list:
It'll only be even more painful. Even 
so...

It'll only be even more painful. Even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even so—I am prepared to see this through 
to the end.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Defeat Central. Defeat Crimson Nova on our 
home turf. Only beyond that does Funabashi 
have a future.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is no longer a matter of my personal 
feelings. As the representative of 
Funabashi, I intend to bring down the 
hammer of justice.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Please... Trainer.

I think about it for a long time. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Diolite Kinen

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

The final stop on the road to revenge. But 
it doesn't feel like a conclusion that 
will clear the air...

The Diolite Kinen. I wasn't able to stop 
Furioso... from heading into a battle with 
no hope of salvation.
